channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Fawley reveals plan for hydrogen in move that could inject £10m boost
item.description: Plans have been unveiled for an energy production facility on part of the former Fawley Power Station site.

item.title: Queen Mary 2 and Queen Anne among ships visiting Southampton this month
item.description: The city is set for a busy period at its cruise terminals in mid-January as several major liners are scheduled to call at the port.

item.title: P&O Cruises' Britannia makes stop in Barbados due to technical issue
item.description: Passengers aboard P&O Cruises' Britannia have experienced technical problems that have forced the ship to divert to Barbados for repairs.

item.title: Calls to demolish iconic Civic Centre building in Fareham
item.description: A councillor called for an iconic 50-year-old building in Fareham to be demolished.

item.title: Heating and water failures shut schools across Southampton and Hampshire
item.description: A spell of cold weather caused disruption to schools across Hampshire yesterday, with a number of schools forced to close after experiencing heating failures.

item.title: P&O Cruises’ Iona marks five years of service from Southampton
item.description: P&O Cruises’ Iona has reached a milestone, marking five years in service since joining the company’s fleet.

item.title: Bid to use room in house as a shop is thrown out - again
item.description: A bid to use a room in a Southampton terraced house as a retail shop selling ladies’ clothing has been dismissed by a planning inspector almost three years after the challenge was launched.

item.title: Southampton shop loses licence after supermarket booze found
item.description: A convenience store has had its alcohol licence revoked after repeatedly failing to provide evidence of how it had acquired supermarket branded drinks that it was selling.

item.title: Man, 56, who died in car park named as inquest opens into death
item.description: An inquest has opened into the death of a Hampshire man who was found dead after he was reported missing.

item.title: Fraudster told to repay burger company 'a drop in the ocean' sum
item.description: A former company secretary has been ordered to repay only £2,510 of the £325,000 he stole from a burger chain founded in Southampton
